description:
hello! I am Keisya, i’d love to make a game about a space mission exploring the forgotten planets in our solar system! We need all the help we can get graphic design, artists and especially coders in our group!

Please contact 4.Interstellar on tiktok!
summary:
Above the stratosphere. 

Experience the wonder of space exploration through the ultimate bedtime story. In this interactive visual novel, players relive a mother’s extraordinary journey to the moon as a NASA astronaut, beautifully framed as a heartwarming tale told to her child.

More than just a narrative, the project blends emotional storytelling with hands-on minigames that put you right in the astronaut's suit. As you navigate the triumphs and challenges of moon exploration, you will uncover a wealth of real-world NASA science, and space facts woven naturally into the adventure.
details: the project makes a fun way of learning a little about something that astronauts can do!
